test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is NOT correct about the Attorney General of India?

options.text: A person qualified to be appointed as the judge of the Supreme Court is eligible for the office of the Attorney General of India.
Article 76 provides for the Attorney General of India.
He/She is considered the highest law officer in the country.
He/She is appointed by the Prime Minister of India.

solution:
The correct answer is __**He/She is appointed by the Prime Minister of India.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Attorney General of India is appointed by the President of India, not the Prime Minister.
 
• As per Article 76 of the Indian Constitution, the Attorney General is the highest law officer in the country.
 
• A person who is qualified to be appointed as a judge of the Supreme Court is eligible for the office of the Attorney General of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Attorney General of India holds office during the pleasure of the President and can be removed by the President at any time.
 
• The role of the Attorney General includes giving advice to the Government of India upon such legal matters and performing such other duties of a legal character as may be referred or assigned to him by the President.
 
• The Attorney General also has the right of audience in all courts in India.
